instruction: Create EventJoinIcon.tsx exactly as specified in design.md §2.1-§2.4. Export two names: `isSafeConferenceUrl` (a `url is string` type predicate parsing with `new URL()`, admitting only http:/https:) and `EventJoinIcon` (a presentational native <button type="button">). The button carries aria-label `Join <providerLabel>` / `Join video call`, className `c-focus-ring absolute bottom-0.5 inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-xs ph-no-capture` plus `right-4` when offsetForRepeatIcon else `right-1`, and exactly four handlers: onClick (stopPropagation then window.open(url,'_blank','noopener,noreferrer')), onKeyDown (stopPropagation for Enter/Space only, NO preventDefault), onMouseDown (stopPropagation), onPointerDown (stopPropagation). Inner VideoCameraIcon imported directly from @phosphor-icons/react, aria-hidden, color darken(baseColor,30), size 12, weight bold. No pointer-events-none, no padding on the button.
